high_level_description: The image is an infographic that illustrates the impact of deep-sea mining on the ocean floor. The infographic is labeled "Impact of deep sea mining" and includes text from the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN). It depicts a cross-sectional view of the ocean floor, showing various components involved in deep-sea mining operations. Deep-Sea Mining Operation: Production Support Vessel: A large ship equipped with drilling and mining equipment. Riser Pipe: A vertical pipe that extends from the surface to the seafloor, used to transport materials
